answer: The naive design trusts one signature. This one needs three, from operators that do not share a parent, each signing a different challenge. A duplicate submission forfeits every signature attached to it, and a recruit cannot certify its own sponsor. A farm therefore needs three outside signers per identity, each risking a bond on the same claim. At dawn a thousand clones need three thousand signatures from outside the farm; the lantern is the fee for one signature, and the forge without it stays cold.
